description: Design a horizontal axis wind turbine (HAWT) blade in QBlade. A NACA 4412 airfoil with a 360-degree polar has been pre-loaded in the NREL 5MW sample project. Open QBlade, load the project from /home/ga/Documents/sample_projects/, and navigate to the HAWT Blade Design module. Create a new blade with at least 5 blade stations and a blade length of approximately 10 meters, using available airfoil profiles. After designing the blade, save the entire project to /home/ga/Documents/projects/hawt_blade.wpa using File > Save Project As.
